- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Fix the FC1 `out_features` of `FusedSharedExpertMLP` for tensor parallel (TP) > 1. Then TE can fuse the shared expert MLP.

## The problem

`_make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops` makes the TE `GroupedLinear` op for FC1 with
`out_features=fc1_weight.size(0) * tp_world_size`. But `fc1_weight` is the local TP shard
(`op.weight0 = fc1_weight`), and `te.pytorch.ops.GroupedLinear` has no TP mode. So the op must use the local size.

With TP > 1, TE does not fuse GroupedLinear + ScaledSwiGLU + GroupedLinear, because
`validate_grouped_mlp_dims` needs `fc1.out_features == 2 * fc2.in_features`.
TE then runs the unfused ops. The unfused `ScaledSwiGLU` needs one scale for each row,
but the shared expert gives one unit scale. The forward pass stops with:

```
transformer_engine/pytorch/csrc/extensions/activation.cpp:367 in function scaled_activation_compute:
Assertion failed: scales_tensor.numel() == rows. scaled activation expects one scale per input row
```

This problem does not occur with TP=1, because then the two sizes are equal.
We found it with DeepSeek-V3 on GB200: TP=2 with sequence parallel, MXFP8,
`use_grouped_gemm_for_shared_expert=True`, and `moe_shared_expert_glu_interleave_size=32`.

## Changes

- Use `out_features=fc1_weight.size(0)` for the FC1 op.
- Remove the `get_pg_size` import, because it has no use now.
- Add `test_make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops_uses_local_shard_sizes_with_tp`.
  The existing tests set the TP size to 1, so they did not find the problem.

## Tests

- `tests/unit_tests/transformer/moe/test_shared_experts.py` on one GB200 node (4 GPUs): 23 tests pass.
  `test_shared_expert_forward_backward[2-4-alltoall]` needs 8 GPUs (TP2 x EP4), so it cannot run there.
- The new test on `main` without this fix fails with `assert 16 == 8`.
- `black`, `isort`, `ruff`, and `pylint` (versions from `pyproject.toml`) pass on the two changed files.
- End-to-end test with the same one-line change on `26.09-alpha.rc2`:
  - Model: a DeepSeek-V3 proxy with 19 layers and 256 experts.
  - System: 16 GB200 nodes, TP2 PP4 VP4 EP16, MXFP8, full-iteration CUDA graph.
  - Without the fix, warmup step 0 stops with the assertion above.
  - With the fix, 10 training steps and the evaluation complete.
  - The eval loss (9.698) agrees with a run that uses the non-fused shared expert (9.696).

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: none. Related: #8024 makes the fused path use the TP group of the module for its collectives.
The two changes do not overlap. A TP > 1 run needs both if `tp_group` is not the global TP group.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] Determinism test for a changed GPU kernel: not applicable, because this PR changes no kernel.
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

@@ -26,7 +26,6 @@
 from megatron.core.transformer.transformer_config import TransformerConfig
 from megatron.core.typed_torch import apply_module
 from megatron.core.utils import (
-    get_pg_size,
     is_te_min_version,
     is_torch_min_version,
     make_sharded_tensor_for_checkpoint,
@@ -485,7 +484,6 @@ def _get_fused_grouped_swiglu_recipe(self):
     def _make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops(self) -> torch.nn.Module:
         """Construct the grouped-linear shared-expert MLP operations."""
         ops = te.pytorch.ops.Sequential()
-        tp_world_size = get_pg_size(self.tp_group)
         rng_state_tracker_function = None
         if get_cuda_rng_tracker().is_initialized():
             rng_state_tracker_function = get_cuda_rng_tracker
@@ -495,7 +493,8 @@ def _make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops(self) -> torch.nn.Module:
         op = te.pytorch.ops.GroupedLinear(
             num_groups=1,
             in_features=fc1_weight.size(1),
-            out_features=fc1_weight.size(0) * tp_world_size,
+            # fc1_weight is the local TP shard and GroupedLinear has no TP, so use the local size.
+            out_features=fc1_weight.size(0),
             device="meta",
             dtype=fc1_weight.dtype,
             bias=False,

@@ -117,7 +117,6 @@ def _patch_fake_shared_expert_te(monkeypatch, linear_cls=_FakeTELinear):
     monkeypatch.setattr(shared_experts_module, "HAVE_TE", True)
     monkeypatch.setattr(shared_experts_module, "te", fake_te)
     monkeypatch.setattr(shared_experts_module, "is_te_min_version", lambda *args, **kwargs: True)
-    monkeypatch.setattr(shared_experts_module, "get_pg_size", lambda group: 1)
     monkeypatch.setattr(
         shared_experts_module,
         "get_cuda_rng_tracker",
@@ -267,6 +266,21 @@ def test_make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops_builds_grouped_pipeline(monkeypatch):
     assert fc2_op.weight0 is shared_expert.linear_fc2.weight
 
 
+def test_make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops_uses_local_shard_sizes_with_tp(monkeypatch):
+    """With TP > 1, FC1 out_features must be the local shard size, so TE can fuse the MLP."""
+    _patch_fake_shared_expert_te(monkeypatch)
+    # Report TP=2 to a TP size lookup. The FC1 and FC2 weights are the TP shards of this rank.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(shared_experts_module, "get_pg_size", lambda group: 2, raising=False)
+    shared_expert = _fake_shared_expert()
+
+    fc1_op, _, fc2_op = list(shared_expert._make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops().children())
+
+    assert fc1_op.kwargs["out_features"] == shared_expert.linear_fc1.weight.size(0)
+    assert fc2_op.kwargs["in_features"] == shared_expert.linear_fc2.weight.size(1)
+    # TE fuses GroupedLinear + GLU activation + GroupedLinear only if FC1 out == 2 * FC2 in.
+    assert fc1_op.kwargs["out_features"] == 2 * fc2_op.kwargs["in_features"]
+
+
 def test_make_fused_grouped_swiglu_ops_builds_clamped_activation(monkeypatch):
     _patch_fake_shared_expert_te(monkeypatch)
     shared_expert = _fake_shared_expert(activation_func_clamp_value=7.0)
